svg.title: Alex Wang: experimental × computational cancer research
svg.desc: Mission-control style banner. Left: the name ALEX WANG, the tagline and tool chips. Right: a circular TME SCAN radar sweeping over a schematic tumour microenvironment of tumour cells, CD8+ T cells and macrophages, with the research loop observe, model, perturb, validate around the dial.

g.text: tumor immunology · functional genomics · single-cell & spatial omics
